name: publication_device_events
description: Transitions in screens' synchronization reports: a newly desired publication delivered, an activation, a failed staging attempt or a playback change (AT-20).
lifecycle: Inserted when a report changes; never updated. Deleted by maintenance 30 days after it occurred.

columns.Meaning: Company that owns the screen; immutable (tenant key).
PostgreSQL-clock instant the transition was received.
Publication the transition concerns, as delivered or reported.
columns.Null meaning: The transition concerns no publication, such as a playback change or an unpublished source.

constraints.Physical definition: FOREIGN KEY (company_id, device_id) REFERENCES devices(company_id, id) ON UPDATE RESTRICT ON DELETE RESTRICT
constraints.Purpose: The screen belongs to the same company.

constraints.Physical definition: CHECK (((kind)::text = ANY ((ARRAY['DESIRED_DELIVERED'::character varying, 'ACTIVATED'::character varying, 'STAGING_FAILED'::character varying, 'PLAYBACK_CHANGED'::character varying])::text[])))
constraints.Purpose: Kinds come from a closed set.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX publication_device_events_company_id_id_key ON public.publication_device_events USING btree (company_id, id)
CREATE INDEX publication_device_events_device_idx ON public.publication_device_events USING btree (company_id, device_id, occurred_at DESC, id DESC)
constraints.Purpose: Reads a screen's recent transitions newest first.

constraints.Physical definition: CREATE INDEX publication_device_events_occurred_idx ON public.publication_device_events USING btree (occurred_at)
